narration: Sand burns under the roar. Marcus steps out onto the floor. Wait, a stray spear drops! Instinct snaps the shield up! One heartbeat too late?

beats.action: Camera establishes wide sunlit Colosseum arena; Marcus stands alert.
Tracking move as Marcus shifts weight forward with grounded steps.
A stray Roman spear slams into the sand by his feet; wide-eyed shock reaction.
Camera dollies closer as Marcus raises and braces his bronze shield.
Reaction close-up hold on determined glare as arena dust settles.
